Name: ICP - Unknown [Demo Tape]
Notes:
Before Gang Starr, DJ Premier was in a group called ICP (Inner Circle Posse, not that group) with a rapper named Top. According to Top, him and Premier made a 4-track demo tape for Wild Pitch Records in an attempt to get signed.
